abstract.t: AI Agents are increasingly accessing web resources on behalf of the users they serve. Traditionally these agents are granted normal OAuth access tokens through existing OAuth grant flows. However, these flows were designed in the era of traditional software, and when applied to AI Agents, multiple problems have arisen. This document outlines some of the problems, and then proposes a simple OAuth2.1 extension that enables AI Agents to obtain access tokens at time of resource access using Human-In-the-Loop or other approval flows. We call this the Agent Authorization Grant (aauth) grant flow. This document also compares the proposed solution with another, non-backwards compatible aauth solution.
